18: class ConnectionManager:
19:     """WebSocket 连接管理器。"""
20: 
21:     def __init__(self) -> None:
22:         self.active: list[WebSocket] = []
23:         self.subscriptions: dict[WebSocket, set[str]] = {}
24: 
25:     async def connect(self, ws: WebSocket) -> None:
26:         await ws.accept()
27:         self.active.append(ws)
28:         self.subscriptions[ws] = set()
29: 
30:     def disconnect(self, ws: WebSocket) -> None:
31:         if ws in self.active:
32:             self.active.remove(ws)
33:         self.subscriptions.pop(ws, None)
34: 
35:     async def broadcast(self, msg_type: str, data: Any) -> None:
36:         """向所有连接广播消息。"""
37:         message = json.dumps({"type": msg_type, "data": data})
38:         disconnected: list[WebSocket] = []
39:         for ws in self.active:
40:             try:
41:                 await ws.send_text(message)
42:             except Exception:
43:                 disconnected.append(ws)
44:         for ws in disconnected:
45:             self.disconnect(ws)
